name: Asadori Shigure
source:
A Miko of Takamagahara, she is a Female Samurai who serves as Tomoe's manservant and bodyguard. As one of the few members of the Imperial Court that Tomoe implicitly trusts, Shigure puts her life on the line when serving Tomoe, and is prepared to sacrifice it for her at any time. As an Oni, she boasts incredible physical strength, and is proficient in the dual-blade technique where one wields both a Greatsword and a Kodachi at the same time.

[From the [url=https://ninetail.info/CF/VenusBloodGAIA_International/en18_character.html]official website[/url]]
